summary: Iteration 287: tested speed-to-lead + weekly wins features end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (GET /api/leads/awaiting/{user_id}, GET /api/home/weekly-wins/{user_id}, GET /api/leads/analytics/response-times with auth + clamping + sorting, conversation info lead flags). Frontend (mobile 390x844, real login forest@imosapp.com): Home red lead-alert-card showed '1 lead waiting 9m / Sally Tester' and navigated to /thread/6a948a5b94f43a817b73d510; /home?wins=1 rendered weekly-wins-card with all 4 stat cells (0 Sold / 26 Texts / 2 QR Scans / 0 New) and card is correctly HIDDEN on non-Monday without the override; Thread amber lead-wait-banner rendered ('New internet lead — waiting 10m · AutoTrader'); sending a message produced a GOLD bubble rgb(201,169,98) with BLACK text, gold send button (rgb(201,169,98)), banner disappeared, and Home lead-alert-card cleared after the human reply; header call + mic are dark circles (#2C2C2E) with gold icons, avatar initials gold; Leads Speed tab renders team-avg row (after I fixed missing DOM testids); Inbox (via bottom tab bar) rows render and lead-wait-chip ('Waiting 7m') verified with a temporary seeded waiting lead; contact profile /contact/69a496841603573df5a41723 still renders quick-actions-row + intel-briefing-card. Two real defects found (phantom cross-conversation ai_draft bubble in thread, residual blue header icons).

minor.issue: Leaks messages from OTHER conversations of the same contact (sibling-conversation + contact_id $or query, messages.py:1699-1731). For test conv 6a948a5b94f43a817b73d510 it returns an unsent ai_draft ('Hey Sally! This is i'M On social... 2023 Ford F-150') that actually belongs to conversations 6a907994af046c430462b9f2 / 6a9079eff2de796445f2a0eb. The draft has sender='ai_draft' and timestamp=None, so the thread UI renders it as an INBOUND grey bubble attributed to the contact ('Sally Tester') with a live clock time (7:58 -> 7:59 -> 8:01 PM across reloads) and it sorts above older real messages, breaking chronological order.

Internet-lead rows return awaiting_first_reply but NOT lead_received_at (null) — inbox chip works only because it falls back to conversation.created_at; thread/[id].tsx:611 relies on lead_received_at from the info endpoint, so keep the two payloads consistent.

Not a code bug but data gap: seeded lead conversations (e.g. Sally Tester) have no inbound_leads document, so replies to them are never 'measured' (overall.measured stays 0, reps=[]). Speed leaderboard therefore shows only the empty rep list.

ui_bugs.issue: Phantom bubble: an ai_draft from a sibling conversation renders as an incoming message from the contact with a constantly-changing 'now' timestamp and appears above older messages (see backend RCA). UI should filter sender==='ai_draft' / messages without timestamps.

All testIDs in leads.tsx are written as raw data-testid props on RN <View>/<TouchableOpacity>; RN-web drops them, so the DOM had ZERO data-testid on /leads (leads-tab-*, leads-filter-*, lead-card-*, roi-source-*, lead-speed-badge-*, speed-* all unqueryable). I converted only speed-overall-stats and speed-rep-* to testID + dataSet; the rest still need conversion.

issues: Residual iOS blue (#007AFF) remains on the back chevron, the search circle button and the '...' overflow icon while call/mic are gold — inconsistent with the dark/gold conversion spec ('no blue').
Subtitle truncates to 'Sally Tester · Respond now …' at 390px width (numberOfLines=1); consider shortening the copy.

action_items: Filter ai_draft / timestamp-less messages out of GET /api/messages/thread (or stop pulling sibling-conversation messages) so unsent AI drafts from other conversations don't render as inbound contact bubbles with live timestamps.
Convert remaining raw data-testid props in /app/frontend/app/leads.tsx to testID + dataSet so the Leads screen is testable on web.
Finish the gold conversion in the thread header: back chevron, search button and '...' icon are still #007AFF.
Optionally include lead_received_at in the conversations list enrichment for consistency with /conversation/{id}/info.
critical_code_review_comments: messages.py get_thread_messages builds a broad $or over sibling conversation ids + contact_id + regex on contact_id — this is a cross-conversation data-bleed vector and also returns draft records; add a sender/status filter and drop the regex clause.
home_intelligence.py: weekly_wins route is declared above the module-level `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` line, which is confusing placement; move route below module setup.
WeeklyWinsCard hides itself when total==0 with no explanatory empty state — silently blank on a real Monday for a new rep.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily inserted conversation 6a948d5ed63bf2d92498027e ('TEST_QA WaitChip', is_internet_lead) + 1 inbound message to verify inbox lead-wait-chip and Home alert; both DELETED after verification. Seeded conv 6a948a5b94f43a817b73d510 (Sally Tester) left intact but now contains the required human reply 'TEST_QA gold bubble check' (sent as part of the gold-bubble test), so awaiting count for user 69a0b7095fddcede09591667 is now 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests: /app/backend/tests/test_speed_to_lead_287.py (awaiting test tolerates count==0 since a human reply was sent this run). To re-test the waiting states you must insert a fresh conversation with user_id=69a0b7095fddcede09591667, is_internet_lead=True, status='active' and no sender='user' message (I did this and cleaned up). RN-web drops raw data-testid props — always use testID + dataSet. /inbox URL is a marketing page on web; reach the app inbox via the bottom tab bar. After editing frontend files, 'sudo supervisorctl restart frontend' is required (hot reload served a stale bundle for my testid fix).
rca_of_the_issue: Phantom thread bubble: GET /api/messages/thread/{cid} intentionally widens its query to sibling conversations of the same contact and to contact_id/regex matches (messages.py:1706-1731). The Sally Tester contact has two other lead conversations containing ai_draft documents (sender='ai_draft', timestamp=None). Those drafts are returned, the UI has no branch for sender 'ai_draft' so it treats them as inbound contact messages, and the null timestamp makes the UI print the current clock time, which also puts them out of chronological order.
